Capex ÷ Cash Flow

live
71.3%
▲+6.8+10.51%

The share of the hyperscalers' operating cash flow going into property and equipment. The closest thing here to a single bubble gauge: below roughly half is a business reinvesting, and a number climbing toward and past 100% is a build being financed by something other than the cash the business throws off. Both legs come from the filings, so it moves four times a year, not daily.
